Exploratory research

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

The Warp Field Notebook is exploratory computational research with explicit limits. Its value here is the practice: numerical checks, failed attempts, corrections, and open questions, all kept and shown. Exploratory work can produce useful methods even when the hypothesis stays unproven.

Mathematics and code only; no demonstration of physical feasibility.
